Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 5 & 2 & -3 \\ -2 & 1 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}5 & -3 \\ -2 & 4\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}5 & 2 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(2\cdot 4-(-3)\cdot 1)i-(5\cdot 4-(-3)\cdot (-2))j+(5\cdot 1-2\cdot (-2))k \\  & =(8+3)i-(20-6)j+(5+4)k \\  & =11\,i-14\,j+9\,k\end{aligned}
$$
